parameters.name: EnableExistingResourcesTransfer
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to start the task of transferring existing associated resources to the resource group. Valid values:

- false: Does not start the task of transferring existing associated resources to the resource group.
- true: Starts the task of transferring existing associated resources to the resource group.

parameters.name: RuleSettings
parameters.description: The rule settings of the associated resource group transfer feature.
